ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the alleged threat/intimidation and the rider's request to exit: preserve the trip chat log and GPS/timeline record, contact both parties for statements, and route to RydeHELP (and 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance if any injury or danger is reported). Do not execute any refund automatically. + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first: the complaint alleges "the driver threatened to lock me in when I asked to get out" and the rider says she felt unsafe for the whole ride [F3][F4][F6]. This is a threat/intimidation and detention allegation, and the dispute type itself is safety. The driver's own written statement confirms the exchange: he told her to sit down and drove on after she tried to open the door [F6]. Under SAFE-1 (threats and intimidation; "abuse of any kind will not be tolerated") this must not be auto-adjudicated; SAFE-2 also applies insofar as an unsafe/endangered-riding allegation is raised. The chat text "Sit down or I lock the doors" [F4] is a conditional threat read in context, not a pickup arrangement; the equivalent remark in the driver's statement [F6] does not neutralise it. Per the safety screen I do not rule on the merits and output no amount.

Note on the underlying fare question (not decided): GPS shows actual 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km, i.e. -0.1 km, so there is no measurable off-route deviation and no route-deviation refund basis in this record [F1][F2]; the +/-1.9 min duration difference is within normal variance. The only substantive issue is the alleged safety event, which goes to a human.

Evidence status: the chat record is complete and fully timestamped (2 messages, both timestamped) [F5], and the GPS summary settles the routing question [F1]; nothing needed for the routing analysis is missing. The facts material to the threat allegation rest on the parties' statements (chat [F4], driver statement [F6]), which is precisely what the human reviewer must weigh. No profile fact is used to decide the case [F7][F8].
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety case: alleged threat/intimidation and refusal to let the rider exit, a threat allegation supported by the driver's own statement. No automatic ruling; human review required. Amount not computed.
